title: JavaScript Clipboard Copy and Paste
title_es: Copiar y Pegar con Clipboard en JavaScript
description: Copy and paste text, HTML, and images with the Clipboard API: execCommand fallback, paste event handling, ClipboardItem, and browser permission quirks.
